comments.body:
Used 31 of these. Got:

Spare sail x1
Pail x2
Mysterious spices x1
Ceasefire Agreement x2
Request Investment Book x1
Quest Mediation Permit x1
Purchase order (Category 2) x1
Purchase order (Category 3) x1
Purchase order (Category 4) x1

Only got a QMP once. POs were far more common; I ended up with PO2x4, PO3x8, and PO4x10 (!). Not a bad reward, all things considered.
